summary: Enumerated every team-mode site across agent-system/extensions/** (source store) plus .claude/**, .opencode/**, and .memory/** for boundary clarity. Team mode is almost entirely one contiguous block in skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md (Stage 3.6+3.6a, lines 952-1262, 19,508 bytes/311 lines) plus ~13 scattered references (Stage 1 team_size_eff derivation, 5 team_mode dispatch forks, 1 MT-1 diagnostics block). synthesis-agent has exactly one caller (Stage 3.6a) and is safe to delete outright along with two team-exclusive context docs (team-metadata-extension.md, team-orchestration.md) and their index-entries.json/manifest.json registrations. Documented full per-file site tables for commands/orchestrate.md, scripts/parse-command-args.sh, merge-sources/claudemd.md, and a dozen context/docs files, plus an extension-agent carve-out sweep (cslib, lean) and a false-positive table (founder team_size metrics, generic 'teammate' handoff vocabulary in handoff-artifact.md/progress-file.md, general-implementation-agent.md's unrelated own Stage 3.6 heading). Flagged .opencode/** and .memory/** as out-of-scope survivors under the literal acceptance grep, with justification (separate freeze/deletion task lineage; inert historical memory).

artifacts.summary: Full site-by-site inventory of team-mode references across the source store, with deletion/edit dispositions, a false-positive table, and an out-of-scope boundary discussion for .opencode/** and .memory/**.

memory_candidates.content: When grepping a codebase for a feature to delete, watch for string-overload false positives: generic vocabulary reused by an unrelated subsystem (e.g. 'teammate' meaning 'successor agent in a context-exhaustion handoff' vs. 'parallel team-mode worker'), coincidental numbering (another file's own '### Stage 3.6' heading unrelated to the target stage), and domain-specific reuse of the same field name in an unrelated extension (e.g. 'team_size' as a startup headcount metric in a pitch-deck generator vs. an orchestrator's parallel-agent count). Build an explicit false-positive table before editing, not just a deletion list.

In this repo, .claude/** is a deploy mirror of agent-system/extensions/core/** (and other extensions), regenerated on deploy — never a separate edit target. .opencode/** is a separate, legacy system with its own freeze/deletion task lineage (independent of the current /orchestrate consolidation), and .memory/** holds historical, inert memory records. A repo-wide grep for a feature being deleted will hit all four locations; only agent-system/extensions/** is ever the edit target, and the other three need per-hit justification rather than editing.
